# Self-service staging: authenticated normal-flow check

## Scope and evidence

The owner privately signed into staging and requested continuation in the test environment. Checks began on 23 October and are recorded here on 24 October. No production CMS release or delivery activation was approved. No automated test suite was added or run. Normal manual interactions used one clearly marked verification entry containing already-public Philippines writing, sources and photographs; no fictional journey/activity was created.

## Observed story workflow

- Uploaded four owner-approved public photographs through the browser's bounded WebP conversion. Selected the Oslob village as overview cover independently of the El Nido banner. Saved wide/top presentation privately, opened a new form, then reopened the saved draft: text, period, banner/crop and chapter assignments were retained.
- Actual preview showed approximately three minutes, Opening and two real chapters, an existing sourced fact and three Oslob photos. Phone preview measured 390px with no wider scrolling content. Manual gallery next advanced 1/3 to 2/3; enlarged next reached 3/3 and close worked. This is browser preview coverage, not a physical-device claim.
- Explicit staging publication created an actual public entry and Stories card using the chosen overview cover. A private revised title and split/centre presentation did not alter the already-open public copy. After preview and explicit republication, the already-open public copy updated through its realtime listener.
- Prepare a Postcard copied the published revision while a different unsaved local story title existed. Withdrawal then made the detail unavailable and removed the Stories card, retaining the private saved draft without saving unsaved form edits.
- Reused the same verification entry as Field Note and observed its card on Field Notes. Reused it again as a text-only sourced fact and observed the Did you know? classification without a card image. Final withdrawal left no verification card on Field Notes. All verification public copies are offline; one private staging verification draft and four unreferenced private media documents remain. No permanent deletion was attempted.
- Downloaded a real v2 JSON backup with four bounded images, independent banner, split layout and chapter assignments. Restoring it populated a new private copy with the expected fields/photos. The restored copy was not saved or published. A misleading dirty-form prompt on selecting the backup file was corrected and the restoration repeated successfully without that prompt.

## Observed private Postcard workflow

Prepared from the published snapshot; edited the optional existing public image and canonical Philippines link; saved privately; reloaded/reopened with fields retained. The initial embedded preview was blank. After 7ccf3f8, the same escaped email template visibly rendered in the actual admin through the inert DOM allowlist and isolated shadow root, with its image decoded. No active href, script, frame or form was present inside the preview. Editing cleared the preview and consent; private save succeeded. Staging Send and Schedule remained disabled even with consent checked; consent was then cleared. One private STAGING CHECK Postcard draft remains. No mail job or campaign was created, changed, scheduled or sent by this work.

The separate read-only Brevo configuration workflow 40020203215 succeeded after the owner's explicitly approved scope and API-IP-setting changes. It confirms configuration access only. No campaign delivery/inbox lifecycle was exercised. The production flag remains absent/off; staging delivery is denied by UI and Rules.

## Corrections and final deployed state

- 3487806 preserves save/publication confirmations instead of replacing them with a repeated connection notice, resets preview scroll/reading estimate and guards stale publication-to-mail and mail-preview responses.
- 7ccf3f8 replaces the blank iframe/Blob preview with strict inert shared-template rendering; existing admin headers remain. Both initial preview methods were observed blank; their cause was not proven.
- d01c64b uses Words by Dainyel for text-only entries and Words & photographs by Dainyel when photos exist. Source and deployed-source were checked; this final wording branch was not visually rechecked after the owner closed the admin tab.
- Staging Hosting runs 40023694191, 40024505217 and final 40025483858 succeeded. Final deployed publishing-desk.js, publishing-model.js, postcard-desk.js, postcard-preview.js and publishing.css matched source after line-ending normalization. Active named-database Rules matched source. A known non-sensitive report URL returned 404. Production admin has neither new editor and was not redeployed.

Screenshots and the actual JSON export remain outside website source in the dated local self-service-publishing artifact folder: staging-postcard-preview-fixed.png, staging-story-phone-preview.png, staging-story-gallery.png, staging-stories-card.png and staging-published-editorial.png. No credentials, owner codes, subscriber records or unreleased travel data were put in this report.

## Remaining boundaries

This was the normal signed-in staging flow, not exhaustive other-account, offline, conflict, security, physical-device, performance or marketing-delivery coverage. Existing static stories are preserved; this editor manages new CMS entries. Twelve bounded photos, explicit external video links and initial generic/static social metadata limitations remain. Production namespace permission and mail activation require a separate reviewed owner-approved release. The site continues to depend on its existing hosting, authentication/database services and their free quotas, independently of Codex.
